chapter: Piron, Pichon and the boat bands
title: Spot jobs with other bands and the Silver Leaf Band
summary: While with Sam Morgan Williams played spot jobs with Piron, Ridgely and others, and recalls Phillip Nixon's Silver Leaf Band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Was this, didn't you play many spot jobs around during the time you were with Sam? Oh yeah. How do you play, I mean with other bands I'm talking about?

Yeah, we played spot jobs with Pierron's band, played spot jobs with Ridley's band. Yeah, all the bands. You see, played all these colored dance halls with Pierron, played all white. With Ridley, played white. Country club, Southern Yacht club.
No, no, what I mean is if you're working regular with Sam, and he's not working that night, would you take a job with another band? Oh yeah, yeah, if they need me, yeah.
I'll go play with other bands.
Such as? How did that work? What you mean? Such as? Who were some of the bands? Oh, some of the bands I'd play with? Yeah, when you were with somebody else.

Oh, some time I played with Oryx when he was here, you know what I'm saying? And I was playing with Pierron and any other band at Warhammer like, oh, several of those bands rock. I played with Rennie, played with Rennie, played with Chris. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. And several others. Jack Carey. Mm-hmm. Played with him. Phillip Nixon, Silver Leaf Band. Who was in that band? Who was in that band?
Yeah, he played with him. Oh, he had... Who did you play with? Yeah. Yeah.

I know he had Sam Dutre, Sam's father, you know. Yeah. And I think he had August Russo on trombone. And, uh, see on trumpet one time, Louis DeMaine, before he got his band. And, uh, trumpetplayer.com, live out in the country. Fine trumpet player. Used to be a male man, used to be insurance man. What is his name?

Hippolyte Charles, yeah. Yeah, yeah. That's right. That's right. Uh-huh. And, uh, who else? I don't know who's playing clarinet or who's playing bass, but I can't think. Cause I was quite young, you know. See, they was playing before I had the band up before I started playing. Mm-hmm. Um, I remember Phillip Nixon well. Tall, brown-skinned father. Kind of like Nelson, but heavy Nelson. So, yeah. Nice guitar player. Mm-hmm.
